'''Whinndor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It had a [[Sulfur/Legends|sulphuric]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] that were abundant with organic molecules. During the [[Republic Dark Age]] the planet was located in a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-contested space, with the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Rusher's Brigade]] once fighting on its surface. The [[Whinndorian gorsk-plant]] was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] species native to Whinndor.

==History==
[[File:Lord_Daiman.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Daiman]], one of the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] to claim ownership of Whinndor.]]

[[File:Vannar_Treece.jpg|150px|thumb|[[Vannar Treece]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] who was concerned about the survival of Whinndor's native life.]]

Shortly before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Operation Influx]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]], Whinndor was positioned on the border between the territories of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]], making it a contested world. It was thought by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] that the fragile biochemical balance of the world might not survive the [[Second Charge Matrica|war]] between the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]], and he mentioned these concerns in a report on the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Spumani sector]] worlds addressed to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

[[File:Odionhead.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Odion]], the other Sith Lord who claimed ownership of Whinndor.]]

Shortly before the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in the same year, the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Rusher's Brigade]] fought on the world, using at least one [[Kelligdyd 25 cannon]]. A member of the brigade loaded the cannon wrongly in the [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence's'']] cargo pod, therefore causing a minor delay while the brigade was deploying on [[Gazzari]] later.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

Over a thousand years later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''[[Lady of Whinndor]]'' was a well-known [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
